paite: Ka phat Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke’n;
heading: David phatna La / Ami Lungzing Phunna

paite: Migilou-salou kam leh kam khemhat ka tung ah ahangsan ngal ua; amau lei zuauthei in ka kiang ah thu agen uhi.
Huatna thu in ahon umsuak ua, bangmah lou in hon dou uhi.
Ka it ziak in hon doute ahong hita uh; himahleh kei zaw thumthum ding in ka kipe tinten hi.
Amau thil hoih thil gilou in ahon thuk ua, ka itna huatna mah in ahon thuk uhi.
Nang atung ah migilou koih inla; ataklam ah hekmi dingh hen.
Vai hawmsak a a-om chiang in siam louh tang in pawt henla; athumna khelhna ah suak hen.
Adamsung nite tom henla; aheutu hihna midang in tang hen.
Atate pa lou in om uhenla, azi mah leng meithai in om hen.
Atate mivakvai hong hi in, khut doh uhenla; anek ding uh amun gamsiate ah zong uhen.
Apung delh a dangka leitawisak in aneih tengteng laksak vek henla; mikhualte'n asepgim gah lok uhen.
Atung a zahngaihna langsak zel ding kuamah om sam kei uhenla; ata pa neiloute hehpihpa ding kuamah om kei hen.
Asuante hihman in om uh henla; khangthak hong om nawn ah amin uh nulmang in om hen.
Apipute uh gitlouh satlouhna TOUPA kiang ah theihgige in om henla; anu khelhna nulmang in om kei hen.
TOUPA ma ah om gige hen. Ama'n amau theihgigena lei a kipan ahihmang theihna ding in.
Zahngaihna latsakna dan atheih louh ua, migenthei, tagah leh khasiate thah tum a asawi zawk ziak un.
Ahi, mi hamsiat a-utlam ahi a, huchi in amah tung ah ahong tung a; mi vualzawl akipah lam ahi kei a, huchi in amah gamlat in a-om hi.
Puanak tual silh bang in hamsiatna in akivan a, huai agilsung ah tui bang in alut a, aguhte ah thau bang in aluanglut hi.
Huai amah a ding in silh gige puansilh bang in om henla, akigak zelna kawnggak mah leng hi hen.
Huai hon doute leh ka hinna gensete TOUPA'N athukna ahi.
Himahleh, TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na min ziak in hon hehpih inla; na zahngaihna ahoih ziak in hon humbit in.
Genthei leh tagahtak ka hi a, ka lungtang ka gilsung ah liam in a-om ngal a.
Liim kiam lam bang in ka mang a; khaupe bang in mutleng in ka om hi.
Ka khukte an ngawl ziak in ahatta kei a; ka sa in thau himhim aputa kei hi.
Amau gensiat ka na hita a; hon muh un alu uh asing uhi.
TOUPA ka Pathian aw, hon panpih inla; aw na zahngaihna bang zel in hon hondam in;
Huai na khut ahi, achih theih ua, TOUPA, nang na hih ahi, chih atheihna ding un.
Amau hamsiat uhen, nang zaw vualzawl zaw in; athohtak un azahlak ding ua, na sikha in bel nuam asa ding hi.
Hon doute zumna puan silhsak in om uhenla, puanak a kivan bang in amau zahlakna in kivan uhen.
Ka kam in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu nakpi in ka gen dia; ahi, mipi lak ah amah ka phat ding hi.
Amah tagahte taklam ah adingh a, hinna vai hawmsakte lak a hondam ding in.
